data.name: ItemCarryAmount
data.shortDescription: Allows you to carry more logs, stones and planks at the same time.
data.description:
# ItemCarryAmount
#### a.k.a "LogCarryAmount"


Makes the player able to pickup multiple logs, stones, planks and carry them.

This is a fork of "LogCarryAmount" by SmokyAce and has been updated to work with the latest release.


## Pickup Multiple

Logs
Stones
Planks

In short terms the mod increases Maximum log, stones, planks carrying capacity.

Now its possible to store logs if you enable it in settings. (Default Key = NUMPAD6, changeable via Mods Settings Menu)

Based on the work of ThirtyTwelve and SmokyAce
